method: Browser only: white original SVG applied to original decoded model; browser front/back screenshots; imagegen creates designed garment views; second imagegen converts approved design to color-guided UV; region-labelled mapping and local correction tested. No Blender used.
initial_mapping: Failed: mapped front/back crests onto sleeve islands and changed some outlines.
identified_mapping: Assistant visually matched colors to numbered UV regions and supplied explicit part and orientation metadata. This is not a deployed independent automatic recognition service.
labelled_result: Torso crests and upright lettering corrected. One sleeve plain, pocket wrong red, front Chinese ribbon occluded.
stage1: White model front/back screenshots produced a coherent two-view designed hoodie with torso lettering and Nordic patterned sleeves.

passed: Front large crest mapped to front torso and upright
Back smaller ornament mapped to back torso and upright
not_passed: Front Chinese ribbon remains occluded by physical pocket; shrink/placement instruction was not followed
Pixel-exact UV boundaries and hood seam coverage not guaranteed
Result is not a faithful reconstruction of all details in stage1 design
final_result.critical_dependency: Explicit region identity and rotation metadata were supplied by this assistant after visually reading the color-coded screenshots. No independent automatic region-recognition service was implemented.

conclusion: Separating appearance design from UV reconstruction yields a clear reference, but does not by itself solve semantic UV matching. Explicit part labels and direction help, then validated print-safe zones and deterministic composition are needed for faithful reconstruction. Text and art remain integrated; no local retypesetting or manual image repositioning was performed on the generated atlases.
